# CWA - chatgpt-web-adapter

> CWA is a local product-runtime bridge for authenticated consumer AI web products. It lets local applications and agents use evidence-backed hosted product capabilities while keeping observation, write authority, retry authority, and finality separate.

## Start

- [Project overview](https://github.com/kymuco/chatgpt-web-adapter/blob/main/README.md)
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/kymuco/chatgpt-web-adapter/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md)
- [Capability map](https://github.com/kymuco/chatgpt-web-adapter/blob/main/docs/capabilities.md)
- [Provider matrix](https://github.com/kymuco/chatgpt-web-adapter/blob/main/docs/providers.md)
- [Agent integration](https://github.com/kymuco/chatgpt-web-adapter/blob/main/docs/agent_integration.md)

## Current proven product surfaces

- ChatGPT: production/default conversational runtime; text, continuation, proven rich input and structured product observations; canonical readback where required.
- DeepSeek Web: experimental module-only text new-chat and continuation; page-DOM stable noncanonical completion.
- Gemini Web: experimental module-only text new-chat and continuation; page-DOM stable noncanonical completion.
- Google Translate Web: experimental module-only text translation; PAGE_DOM_STABLE_TRANSLATION; no conversation identity.

## Integration

- Python package: chatgpt-web-adapter
- Python import: chatgpt_web_adapter
- CLI: cwa / chatgpt-web-adapter
- Python 3.10-3.14
- Browser-owned execution is the reference/default strategy for ordinary consumer web products.
- MCP adapter: planned direction, not currently shipped.

## Important invariants

- Product observation is not product approval.
- Capability availability is not caller authorization.
- Incremental output is not canonical finality.
- Ambiguous product writes are not automatically retried.
- CWA is not an official API client for OpenAI, Google, or DeepSeek.
- Product-specific browser mechanics stay below public runtime contracts.
